capabilities.description: Validate required transaction fields and return privacy-conscious dataset coverage diagnostics without exposing rows.
Compare candidate detector settings with active findings without changing the current dataset or settings.
Validate a dataset, run the AML analysis pipeline, and return ranked alerts with transaction evidence.
Build a chronological alert timeline, bounded graph context, and evidence-linked alternative explanations.
Run a synthetic motif scenario and compare graph detection with configured baselines.
Prepare a case draft, validate evidence links and digest against the active dataset, and return Markdown only when checks pass.
Compare held-out metrics across two bounded deterministic synthetic benchmark seeds and report seed sensitivity.
Run a reproducible benchmark and report metrics, counterexamples, and drift indicators.
